## Objective

An exported bundle can be checked against its schema and compared with the service without changing anything.

## Scope

As stated in the objective and acceptance criteria; nothing beyond them.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Exported notes are validated against the versioned schema: identifiers, dates, types
- [ ] differences between an edited export and the service are reported as drift
- [ ] nothing is written back without a proposal and approval

## Test requirements

Integration tests.

## Deliverables

Code or configuration, tests, and updated documentation for this ticket.
